title: Dia_(web_browser)
summary:
Dia is a proprietary Chromium-based web browser developed by The Browser Company of New York. The browser integrates an AI assistant that users can interact with through the browser interface, including asking questions about open tabs and generating text based on tab content.

In December 2024, The Browser Company announced that their second product, Dia, would launch in early 2025. On May 27, 2025, The Browser Company's Josh Miller explained the reasons for stopping Arc development and focusing solely on Dia instead. TechCrunch described Dia as presenting a conventional browser layout while centering its AI assistant as a primary interaction point.

Dia includes a Skills feature for task-oriented shortcuts, with both built-in and user-created actions for workflows such as summarization, outlining, planning, writing, and coding. In August 2025, The Browser Company introduced a paid subscription tier, Dialed In, priced at US$20 per month, which provides expanded or unlimited access to certain AI features.

In September 2025, Atlassian announced an agreement to acquire The Browser Company for US$610 million, and later announced it had completed the acquisition in October 2025. Also in October 2025, Dia became broadly available to macOS users without an invitation, following an earlier waitlist period. It requires macOS 14 or later and Apple silicon hardware.
